column1: # Recoup failure taxonomy - maps Razorpay error_reason -> recovery-relevant root cause.
# The reason + error_class columns are verbatim from that page. Everything to the
# right of them is a Recoup judgement call and is what the policy engine consumes.
# The insight this file encodes: for revenue recovery the ~120 error reasons collapse
#   1. root_cause        why the money did not move (16 buckets)
#   2. retry_class       when, if ever, another attempt is worth making
#   3. new_instrument    whether retrying the SAME instrument is provably futile
#   4. customer_action   whether a human must act (i.e. whether contact is warranted)
# ...plus in_scope: whether this is recoverable revenue at all, or a merchant
# integration bug / ops ticket that must be routed AWAY from the recovery queue
# instead of dunned. Dunning a customer over our own invalid_order_id is the single
# most expensive mistake this system can make.
